_about: Run boons: team-wide rule changes for the rest of the run, won by a team vote (each milestone, and sometimes a boss kill). Effects are built into the mod by id; name, desc, code (2 letters, HUD), color, rarity (0 common, 1 rare, 2 very rare) and weight (how often it's offered) can be changed here.

boons.name: Second Wind
boons.desc: The first death each level (anyone's) is saved: back up at 1 HP, without using anyone's death save charges.

boons.name: Salvage Line
boons.desc: Every finished extraction heals everyone alive 6 HP (counts toward the Max Extraction Heal cap).

boons.name: Bone Collectors
boons.desc: Monsters drop 50% more crafting parts.

boons.name: Light Load
boons.desc: Haul goals are 10% lower.

boons.name: Hold the Line
boons.desc: Deaths cost the streak half as much (rounded down).

boons.name: Bounty Board
boons.desc: Every elite killed pays every player 10 Scrap (a boss 30).

boons.name: Easy Money
boons.desc: Contract targets are 20% lower (rounded up: kill 8 becomes kill 7).

boons.name: Free Estimate
boons.desc: The first contract board reroll each visit is free.

boons.name: Hazard Pay
boons.desc: Every elite killed adds +1% to that level's haul Scrap (at most +10%).

boons.name: Head Start
boons.desc: The first extraction each level fully recharges everyone's ability.

boons.name: Spare Parts
boons.desc: Crafting costs 1 fewer of each kind of part (never below 1).

boons.name: Full Sweep
boons.desc: Finishing every extraction point on a level pays everyone 15 Scrap and a tenth of a level's XP.

boons.name: Lucky Break
boons.desc: 1 in 10 gear finds rolls one rarity higher.

boons.name: Lone Wolf
boons.desc: When only one player is left alive (2+ players): they take 30% less damage and move 15% faster (the caps still apply).

boons.name: Rapid Response
boons.desc: A revived player can't be hurt for 5 seconds.

boons.name: Tip Jar
boons.desc: Contracts pay 15% more Scrap.

boons.name: Crowd Control
boons.desc: Elites are 20% rarer and never have more than one modifier (bosses are unchanged).

boons.name: Marked for Death
boons.desc: Bosses take 15% more damage from everyone.

boons.name: Safety Net
boons.desc: The streak never falls below a third of the best streak this run.

boons.name: Quick Study
boons.desc: Everyone earns 10% more XP (inside the XP bonus cap).

boons.name: Data Mine
boons.desc: All Research Data earned is 20% higher.

boons.name: Stockpile
boons.desc: Every shop restock has one more Featured item.

boons.name: Deep Pockets
boons.desc: Milestone Scrap payouts are 30% higher.
